data.explanation: This letter confirms your MRI (Magnetresonanztomographie) appointment for your right knee. Arrive 15 minutes early at the ground-floor registration desk, and bring your health insurance card (Versichertenkarte), the referral (Überweisung), and any earlier findings (Vorbefunde) if you have them. Remove any metal objects before the scan, as these can interfere with the machine. No payment or written reply is needed now; if you cannot make the date, contact the practice beforehand to reschedule.
